## Type of change

## Validation

- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `black --check .` passes
- [ ] `mypy src tools local_emulator` passes
- [ ] `pytest` passes (coverage >= 85%)
- [ ] `terraform fmt -check -recursive` + `terraform validate` pass
- [ ] No real secrets, credentials, account IDs, or PII added

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] Docs updated where relevant
- [ ] Commit messages follow conventional commits
